highlights: Green Lion Finder GPS Smart Watch
The Green Lion Finder GPS Smart Watch with a slate of advanced features presents a stylish place.
It comes with a sturdy zinc-alloy case with a more limb offered by a comfortable silicone strap.
The display is an AMOLED type measuring 2.01 inches, with a resolution of 410×502 and 1000 nits brightness, ensuring a vibrant and clear view.
The 400mAh battery rendition ensures that the watch stays functional for 3-5 days with active use and a standby time of 15 days.
It supports Bluetooth 5.3, Bluetooth calls, local music, and health metrics tracking. It is waterproof up to 5ATM, perfect for outdoor activities.
It supports over 170 sports modes, AI watch faces, GPS, compass, barometer, and altitude tracking.
With magnetic charging and a charging time of less than 3 hours, the Green Lion Finder GPS Smart Watch is indeed for those who desire equal style and functionality.
